summary: A private 2 to 5-day charter along the Shoryudo route from Nagoya through Takayama, Shirakawa-go and Kanazawa, with a Mandarin-speaking driver and guide.
body:
## What this tour is

This is a private multi-day charter that follows the Shoryudo route through central Japan, starting and ending in Nagoya. Instead of a fixed group departure you have a private vehicle with a driver and guide for two to five days, and you choose how far along the route to go.

## The route it describes

The listing names a string of stops along the way: the post towns of Magome and Tsumago, the old streets of Hida and Takayama, the thatched houses of Shirakawa-go, the gardens and teahouse districts of Kanazawa, Gero Onsen hot springs, Inuyama and the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route. It describes the journey as connecting mountains, old roads and hot-spring towns, with flexible itineraries that mix culture and nature.

## Language

The driver and guide service is described as Chinese-speaking, with the driver language given as Mandarin. English is not mentioned, so check with KKday if you need it.

## Vehicle and booking

Cars are a 7-seater or a 10-seater, and a child seat can be rented. The page shows a price from US$822.28 for the package option, and says free cancellation applies up to 5 days before the date. The booking is confirmed one day after ordering rather than instantly.

## What the excerpt does not say

The text we read did not give the per-day itinerary, what the price includes beyond the vehicle, or how accommodation is handled. The page's own "service details" section is where to look before you commit, as a five-day trip is a large booking.

## When it fits

It suits a small group that wants a private, flexible loop through the Japanese Alps region and is comfortable with a Mandarin-speaking guide. If you prefer a shared tour or an English guide, look elsewhere.
